races.paceDynamic: Bye Bye Now will set uncontested fractions from the gates with only An Laochmor, Snowballs and Jordan Breeze likely to press early. The sustainable tempo over 5f on turf will allow prominent runners to track comfortably while the large contingent of hold-up horses (Whats It All About, Sceitimini, Jazzit, Phil's Dream, Star Reign, Cooee Call, She's A Gift) will need the pace to collapse to be competitive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bye Bye Now Controls
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader maintains steady fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: Bye Bye Now dictates throughout and holds off late challengers. The prominent trio struggle to make serious inroads against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If An Laochmor, Snowballs and Jordan Breeze all press Bye Bye Now from the start
scenarios.body: The increased tempo compromises all four early runners in the final furlong. Phil's Dream and Jazzit benefit from the stronger pace with late surges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three prominent runners settle well and kick together turning for home
scenarios.body: An Laochmor, Snowballs and Jordan Breeze overwhelm the lone leader with superior tactical speed. The hold-up brigade arrive too late despite the modest early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Bye Bye Now sets slower fractions than expected and multiple closers get organized
scenarios.body: Phil's Dream and Jazzit time their runs perfectly as the pace collapses completely. The early runners pay for the pedestrian tempo with comprehensive defeat.

watchPoints.text: Bye Bye Now could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions with no other natural leaders in the field
Jordan Breeze and An Laochmor both show fading tendencies despite their prominent styles creating tactical concerns
Multiple hold-up horses including Whats It All About, Sceitimini and Star Reign have recent finishing problems
Phil's Dream has won twice recently over 5f and could benefit if the prominent runners go too fast early
The good going suits most runners but several including Jordan Breeze and multiple hold-up types have shown fading patterns recently

races.paceDynamic: Mc Loven will lead uncontested as the only confirmed front-runner, setting a comfortable tempo without early pressure. The real battle develops behind with Beauty Queen, Dontspoilasale, I Bid You Ajou, I'm Spartacus, and Edmond Halley all wanting prominent positions, creating congestion and tactical complications turning for home when the hold-up brigade of six strong finishers unleashes.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven gets soft fractions and the prominent pack interferes with each other
scenarios.body: The leader builds a decisive advantage while the chasers jostle for position, then holds off late challenges weakened by traffic problems. Mc Loven's stamina proves enough when not harassed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Charge Through
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard chasing Mc Loven and create openings
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong as tired leaders surrender to fresh finishers who avoided early trouble. Collective Power and Sporting Hero benefit most from clean runs through gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures the perfect stalking position without over-racing
scenarios.body: Beauty Queen or I'm Spartacus gets first run on the leader while avoiding the worst of the scrimmaging behind. They kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Favors Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If severe interference mars the finish with multiple horses checking
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with several contenders blocked or short of room at crucial moments. Amemri or another outsider profits from the clearest passage to steal victory.

watchPoints.text: Edmond Halley has virtually no form on good ground (1 run from 15) making him a complete unknown

Collective Power's perfect going record means any market drift would be significant negative signal
Mc Loven's early fractions will determine everything - watch for any pressure from the prominent pack
I'm Spartacus and Beauty Queen must secure clean positions early or risk being trapped behind stragglers

races.paceDynamic: Love Bomb stands as the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field, likely to get an uncontested lead with Royal County Glory and Stone Bear the closest prominent runners but unlikely to apply serious early pressure. This sets up a tactical affair where Love Bomb can dictate terms early, but the overwhelming number of hold-up horses (9 runners) creates a bunched finish where stamina and position will be crucial over finishing power.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb gets easy fractions and doesn't fade as usual
scenarios.body: Love Bomb controls the pace without pressure and has enough left to resist the late charge. The prominent runners Royal County Glory and Stone Bear fill the places as the hold-up brigade arrives too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and favors stamina over speed
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows the classier hold-up horses to unleash devastating finishing kicks. Faustyna and One Cool Bear benefit most from the patient approach with their higher ratings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb fades as expected and pace pressure builds
scenarios.body: Royal County Glory and Stone Bear capitalize on their forward positions as Love Bomb weakens in the final furlong. Their tactical speed proves superior to the hold-up horses who get caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and a stop-start pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and several horses getting hampered in the straight. Lady Landhort's recent win gives her confidence while Pretty Liz finds gaps from her patient style.

Stone Bear's recent course win makes him dangerous if getting prominent position

One Cool Bear's high rating means any sign of holding his form makes him dangerous

races.paceDynamic: With multiple prominent runners (Mehmar, Comfort Line, Alex Belardo, Punk Poet, Master Garvey) likely to press forward, this will develop into a genuinely-run contest from the outset. The abundance of hold-up horses (Palazzo Persico, Kitty Bear, Star Mind, Alto Sax, Deep Vein, Hi George) suggests the pace will be solid throughout, creating opportunities for late closers if the prominent group goes too hard early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group maintains even pressure without overdoing it early
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest but sustainable, allowing the front-runners to stay strong late. Hold-up horses struggle to make significant inroads against the established rhythm.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Mehmar, Comfort Line and Alex Belardo engage in early pace pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent runners compromise each other through the first half-mile, setting up perfect conditions for closers. The pace collapses in the final two furlongs as fresh horses arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Development
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners show mutual respect and go too slowly early
scenarios.body: A stop-start tempo develops with the large hold-up contingent bunched behind a dawdling pace. The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole, favoring horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Injection Fails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and hold-up horses are trapped
scenarios.body: Solid early fractions are maintained to the line, preventing the back-markers from making their usual late moves. The race stays up front with prominent runners dominating.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm and Expound will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set an honest gallop over this staying trip. With most of the field carrying hold-up tactics, the pace battle between these two leaders should create a strong end-to-end tempo that will test stamina reserves and favor horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm and Expound burn each other out in a sustained pace battle
scenarios.body: The two front-runners will weaken dramatically in the final furlong after setting too strong a pace. Late-running specialists like Liberate and Yosemite Gold will sweep past the tiring leaders with powerful finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm gets an uncontested lead while Expound settles behind
scenarios.body: With a clear advantage up front, Timeless Charm will dictate ideal fractions and kick clear in the straight. Expound will chase hard but cannot reel in the leader who has conserved energy perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with Echinacea and Baila Conmigo moving up to challenge the leaders mid-race
scenarios.body: A bunched field will create traffic problems and tactical complications turning for home. Horses with good positioning like Sir Callisto and Beat The Devil will find cleaner runs to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain their challenge to the line in a genuine staying test
scenarios.body: The honest pace will turn this into a true test of stamina over the extended trip. Only the most genuine stayers like Billie Frechette and Derry Lad will handle the sustained effort required.

watchPoints.text: Timeless Charm and Expound could set suicidal fractions if they engage in a prolonged speed duel from the start.
Traffic problems likely in the straight with so many hold-up horses converging from the back simultaneously.
Derry Lad, Edge Of Darkness and Brandon Creek all show concerning patterns of fading when races intensify.
Billie Frechette has never finished out of the frame on similar going conditions.
Yosemite Gold's recent course and distance victory makes him particularly dangerous if getting the right pace setup.
